threat.detail: Yone and Shige, onryō who kill samurai like cats
threat.quote: the vengeful spirits, or onryō, of a woman and her daughter-in-law, who are raped and murdered by a band of samurai

threat.detail: linked to the bakeneko of folklore
threat.quote: They seduce and then kill the samurai like cats, tearing their throats with their teeth

origin.quote: Yone and her daughter-in-law Shige, who live in a house in a bamboo grove, are raped and murdered by a troop of samurai
They have made a pact with the underworld to return and kill samurai in revenge for their deaths

wants.quote: to return and kill samurai in revenge for their deaths
